utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s still going nicely—folks have been dropping things off all afternoon. I can swing by later and see if they still need help sorting anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Tess—thank you. If you can check on the sorting later, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing—I’ll swing by later and check whether they still need help sorting. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I still don’t have the exact time handy, but I can check the repair list. Let’s sort the route details at the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good, Bo—I can help spread the word once the time’s set. Just let me know the route details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Jules—I’ll check the list and get back to you with the route details. Let’s meet at the community hall once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Kira—I’m heading past the community center later, so I’ll check if they still need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on for today, right? If you’re passing the community center, please confirm whether they need anything beyond the front steps and railing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it’s still on for today—I’ll check on the front steps and railing, and see if they need anything else too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo—what time were you thinking for the repair drive? I can help work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: After school works best for me—around 4:30. I can bring the tools I mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 4:30 works for me—I’ll plan around pickup and be there after school. Thanks for bringing the tools, Leo.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I can help check the path and move those loose boards. Just let me know when you want to do it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help, Sam. If we can confirm a drop-off spot and the pickup plan too, I’ll feel much better about it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I can help confirm the drop-off spot and pickup plan too. What details do you already have?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, 10 in the morning works for me. Thanks for bringing the gloves and trash bags—that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll bring up the repair drive and see who can help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Vik—that’d be a big help. Let me know if you need me to bring anything else.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I can help with the repair drive—what else do we still need?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—what time are we heading out, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m thinking we head out around 10, and if you can bring some gloves and a few tools, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve still got them — I’ll bring the wrench set and screwdriver over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that’ll help a lot. I’m still waiting on the time and place, but I’ll pass along any update I hear as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem — just let me know when and where, and I’ll be there with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you tell me the exact time and which houses are on the list for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m sorry, I don’t have the exact time or list handy. If you can send me the latest update, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I don’t have the latest update with me right now, but I’ll check and send it over when I have it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got the nails and tape noted. Just keep sending me anything else you gather, and I’ll stay on top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and send you anything else I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep the list updated as things come in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, thanks. Let me know what time works and I can stop by to help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m on it — I’m checking the repair drive’s next stop now, and I’ll let you know as soon as I confirm it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good — I’ll wait for your update, and I can head over when you’ve got the time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — just keep me in the loop on what’s still needed, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Uli — I’ll keep you posted. Right now we’re set for Sunday at the community center, and the front steps and railing are the main priorities.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Got it — thanks for the update. I’ll help with whatever I can and keep it quiet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still a bit uneasy about the logistics—do we have a clear drop-off spot and someone lined up for pickups?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: We should set a clear drop-off spot and line up pickup help—I'll check what’s confirmed and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Mara — that’d ease my mind a lot. Let me know what’s confirmed, and I can help fill in any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. Could you bring a hammer, some screwdrivers, and maybe a drill if you’ve got one?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll bring a hammer, screwdrivers, and a drill if I have one.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik — that should help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you let me know the exact time and which houses are on the repair drive list? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before we head out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I don’t have the exact time or house list yet, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I get it. Thanks for checking in!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules. Please let me know as soon as you have the time and house list, and I’ll be ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good—if they still need help, I can stop by later and sort things out. Just give me a shout if you hear the next stop.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll grab the repair list and meet you by the community hall.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll meet you by the community hall then. I’m around if you need an extra hand sorting the repair drive stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—please bring both over for the repair drive. I’ll have the rest ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll bring both over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect, thanks. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — it’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. If you hear of anyone who can lend a hand, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Rosa — I’ll keep the community center in mind and send anyone I hear of your way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate that. It’ll help a lot if we can get a few more hands for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks — just keep me posted on what’s still needed, and I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I’ll let you know if anything changes on the repair drive. I can miss updates sometimes, so feel free to remind me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll check in if I haven’t heard anything. Keep me posted when you can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, definitely—I’ve already started spreading the word, and I can invite a few more neighbors too. Just let me know if anything changes for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Quinn—I really appreciate it. I’m heading by the community center later, so I’ll check whether they still need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good, Ira—thanks! If you hear they need extra hands or supplies, just let me know and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Sam — I’m still around and ready to help with whatever they need. Just let me know if you hear they’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do — thanks, Oren. If I hear they need anything else for the drive, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’m nearby if they need a hand with anything else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still sorting out what we need most, so if you’ve already got anything on hand, let me know and I’ll add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ve got a few spare extension cords and some basic tape, and I’ll keep an eye out for more after school. I’ll let you know if anything else turns up before 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Faye — I’ve added the extension cords and tape to the list. Let me know if anything else turns up before 10.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s really happening this afternoon, then? I’ll grab the repair list if the front steps and loose railing are still the priority.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, that’s still the priority. Bring the repair list if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, I’ll bring it by. I’m just checking—are there any other parts you want me to look for, or is the list enough?
